items.title: Lt. Gen. Ben Hodges accuses Hegseth of 'getting rid of people who may have the courage to push back'
items.summary: Erin Ogunkeye welcomes Lt. General (ret.) Ben Hodges, former commander of US Army Europe and NATO Allied Land Command. The dismissal of senior military officers without public explanation raises fundamental questions about institutional trust and the relationship between civilian authority and military leadership. For General Hodges, the reported firing of Lt. General Brett Sylvia reflects a potentially troubling pattern within the Pentagon under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Equally striking is his criticism of the reluctance of retired senior commanders to speak publicly against policies they consider damaging. Hodges said he was "disappointed and surprised" by the limited public resistance among former four-star generals.

items.title: Brazil’s victory for the planet and democracy: seven lessons from Lula’s win
items.summary: The trouncing of the far right provides a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France Thank you, Brazil, for demonstrating how the far right can be trounced while protection for the Amazon is strengthened. In a world where nature and democracy appeared to be bleeding out in tandem, voters and forest defenders in this global south powerhouse have shown it is possible to staunch the flow. This should provide much needed inspiration and, more practically, a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France. The astonishing comeback victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Sunday’s presidential runoff against his extreme right challenger Flavío Bolsonaro has brought oceans of rapturous supporters on to the streets, while also thrilling conservationists, climate activists and social justice campaigners across the world. items.title: 'An absurdity' to blame human error: Spain's deadly train crash 'should never' have happened
items.summary: Following Spain's deadly high-speed train crash, Delano D'Souza is joined by Francisco Badea, Director of FEM Expert Engineering, Railway Structural & PRM Certification Expert. Batea challenges explanations that reduce railway disasters to isolated human mistakes. “It is basically an absurdity to say that it depended on one person and one human mistake,” he argues, emphasizing that modern railway networks operate through multiple layers of protection, including automated safeguards, train-detection technologies, operational protocols and institutional oversight. “The system has been designed in a way that this type of accident should never happen.”

Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula lurks within sight of Hubble and Webb
items.summary: The NASA/ESA Hubble and the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescopes recently stared at an eerie star-forming scene within the Carina Nebula, a massive gas and dust cloud located approximately 7500 light-years away from Earth. The two telescopes offer complementary views of the shadowy form, nicknamed the Cat’s Head Nebula, which reflects the 'magical'' process of star formation. Hubble’s visible-light view shows the cat as a dark, elongated dust pillar and hints of young forming stars, while Webb’s infrared-light imagery unveils many stars and other hidden details.

items.title: Campagna di comunicazione istituzionale “Carta Dedicata a Te”
items.summary: Il Ministero dell’agricoltura, della sovranità alimentare e delle foreste lancia la nuova campagna di comunicazione istituzionale “Carta Dedicata a Te”, una carta destinata alle famiglie in maggiore difficoltà economica per l’acquisto di beni alimentari di prima necessità, con valorizzazione delle filiere nazionali e dei prodotti DOP e IGP. La “Carta Dedicata a Te” è una carta elettronica di pagamento, prepagata e ricaricabile, messa a disposizione da Poste Italiane. Coinvolge oltre un milione di nuclei familiari residenti in Italia, con ISEE inferiore a 15.000 euro e privi di altri strumenti di inclusione sociale o sostegno alla povertà. I possessori della Carta, inoltre, potranno beneficiare di uno sconto aggiuntivo del 15% sulla spesa nei punti vendita aderenti. Lo spot illustra i tempi di attivazione della carta e quelli di erogazione dei 1000 euro disponibili per ogni nucleo familiare. Il claim è “Carta dedicata a te, un aiuto per le famiglie e le imprese italiane”. Per tutte le informazioni consultare il sito . articles.title: Ex Ilva, chiude l'area a caldo: "Salvi i bambini di Taranto"

claims.text: Il Governo non può che prendere atto della pronuncia della Cassazione su ex Ilva, che disattende le motivate conclusioni della Procura generale della stessa Cassazione. Lo stesso Governo non si sottrarrà all’esercizio delle proprie responsabilità, come ha fatto finora, come confermato dal decreto-legge entrato in vigore qualche giorno fa e come ribadito nell’incontro con i sindacati svolto a Palazzo Chigi martedì scorso. È evidente che questa sentenza, il cui contenuto va approfondito, complica ulteriormente un percorso che è stato sempre più difficile e costellato da ogni tipo di ostacoli.
